_: The physical world when a scheme is off. mesh_bindings is closed-world: every built node or dressing rule that exists because of a scheme is named here. becomes is a design decision, not a viewer instruction.
_authored: Authored data, not generated. The 'estate-review package 4' this file once named as its generator does not exist in the tree; the false generated_by was removed on 17 September 2026. A scheme's felled_stems is the one machine-checkable number here: the scheme names its felling predicate and rule R38 derives the count from that predicate and refuses any difference.

survey.albedo: existing terrain albedo before scheme treatment
survey.trees: Felled survey stems are not reinstated: a tree felled for works remains a factual loss in both worlds, not a reversible rendering option.

Sch_CourtyardPool.label: Courtyard pool house, plant and gym

becomes.ground: existing courtyard fabric remains; the pool asset's own paving and plant go

Sch_CourtyardPool.note: The pool is a proposal inserted into standing courtyard fabric. No terrain grading is baked for it.

Sch_StaffVillage.label: Staff village, Meadows North, 80 beds

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo; no terrain grading is baked for the village

Sch_StaffVillage.note: Three source tree indices are removed by the village footprint. They are not resurrected by a scheme toggle. | felled_stems 3 is the village record's felled-tree index list, the index list the build's tree stage reads; the predicate is named here and derived by R38, not hand-counted.

Sch_Gatehouses.label: Gatehouses and lodge extensions, staff

becomes.ground: the already-survey terrain under all five gatehouse placements; no separate serving ground node is emitted

Sch_Gatehouses.note: Measured build inventory has no gatehouse hardstanding, kerb, planting or graded-terrain node to bind. Binding shared estate terrain would wrongly hide existing fabric.

Sch_RiverClub.label: River Club Building, Thames Frontage

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo in the formal River Club corridor; existing Long Water water remains

Sch_RiverClub.note: The 116.75 m formal corridor grade and Club precinct are scheme works; the Long Water's copings, threshold and swim steps are the swimming switch's (28 Sep 2026). The coping stems stay in this switch's felling predicate, which fells for the precinct as one design. The eighteenth-century canal is existing fabric. | water-long-water.precinct.metal_dark retired with the mouth sluice on 15 September 2026: with only the head third treated the sluice has nothing to isolate, so the build emits no metal_dark bundle to bind. | felled_stems 9 is the count the River Club precinct's felling rule returns for the 2,512-stem survey array (indices 94, 102, 110, 154, 155, 221, 257, 1124, 1933; deck 5, weir 1, canal copings 4, allee 2, garden 0, with overlaps). The file carried 8 from generation 10 until 17 September 2026: it was a hand count, never compared to the predicate, and the precinct's felling has moved since. R38 derives the number now.

Sch_LongWaterSwim.label: Long Water isolated and treated for swimming

becomes.ground: the existing Long Water and surveyed banks remain; its copings, threshold and swim steps go

Sch_LongWaterSwim.note: This is a modification switch: the Long Water stands either way. Its treatment - the dressed copings and threshold at the head (or the mouth, the viewer's alternative), and the swim steps - is the swimming works and goes with this switch (28 Sep 2026; until then the steps went with the River Club and the copings with nothing).

Sch_MirrorWing.label: Main House mirror wing and three keys in the existing wing

becomes.ground: existing garden lawn on the Main House's south (Thames-facing) side, with the two surveyed stems the wing fells standing again

Sch_MirrorWing.note: Measured against the LIDAR survey: the wing's footprint (the wing asset's measured extent, turned and placed by its own placement) holds one surveyed stem (index 2144, 4.06 m) and a second stands 4 m off its wall (index 1716), inside the same 5.0 m working band the lodges fell to. No other survey unit, building or hardstanding, falls inside it. The mirror wing's felling rule is the one predicate; the trees stage draws both stems, from their own draws, into the survey node the viewer shows while the switch is off.

Sch_Lodges.label: Woodland lodges, nine hotel keys

becomes.ground: existing woodland, with the twelve surveyed stems the lodges fell standing again

Sch_Lodges.note: Measured against the LIDAR survey through the lodge planting rule, the one predicate: the nine hand-set lodges fell twelve surveyed stems standing inside a footprint or within 5.0 m of one. The trees stage redraws those stems, from a stream of their own, into the survey node the viewer shows while the switch is off, so the lodges' woodland is whole in the base. No access-road or service-connection geometry is modelled for the lodges (v92 capex line 208 costs an access the estate model does not yet draw); the switch controls the nine lodge buildings and their fellings only.

Sch_Marquee.label: Wedding marquee

becomes.ground: existing lawn on the Main House garden side; nothing is felled, on or off

Sch_Marquee.note: Measured against the LIDAR survey and the wedding-marquee asset's own bounding box (about 13.6 x 8.05 m half-extents about its placement, x -13.58..13.55 / z -8.05..8.05 in the marquee asset): the nearest surveyed trunk is 18.4 m from the placement, clear of the footprint, so switching this on fells no stem. The marquee is a temporary hired structure with no permanent base.

Sch_MainHouseWing.label: Main House dining wing, 127 m2 new build

becomes.ground: the existing Main House court and core datum remain; no wing-only ground treatment is emitted

Sch_MainHouseWing.note: The build has no south-wing-specific hardstanding or grade. The shared Main House ground must not be bound to a wing-only switch.

Sch_RidingMezzanine.label: Riding School mezzanine, 230 m2

becomes.ground: standing Riding School and its existing ground remain

Sch_RidingMezzanine.note: The mezzanine modification has no separately emitted geometry.

Sch_FloatingBar.label: Floating Long Water Bar, 75 m2

becomes.ground: existing Long Water water and surveyed banks remain; the floating-bar element is presently built=false

Sch_FloatingBar.note: No bar mesh, approach, mooring or shore treatment is emitted in the measured build. | prop.floating-bar is built=false in the registry (no geometry), so it carries no mesh binding; the scheme is capex-only until it is modelled.

Sch_TennisPadel.label: Tennis and Padel Courts

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo; the courts platform is not yet built

Sch_TennisPadel.note: The 33.330 mAOD platform is a recorded design but the current build deliberately leaves the courts on existing terrain.

Sch_SpaGarden.label: Spa Garden

becomes.ground: survey terrain and existing albedo under the spa-garden work

Sch_SpaGarden.note: The Spa Garden surface is a scheme proposal over the shared core grade; its off-state requires a local survey overlay rather than hiding the estate-wide core. | The survey species nodes are the species the planting actually fells (broadleaf and cedar): a test derives them from the spa planting rule and refuses any hand-listed species - the retired poplar and veteran entries - that the planting does not carry. | prop.spa-garden is built again on 15 September 2026 as physical fabric inside the spa precinct asset (spa-precinct-garden): the switch owns the scheme ground, the planting and the garden fabric node. | The ground region is the precinct's three garden zones (entrance side, spa pool side, leisure garden face) carried as one rotated rectangle at the precinct's own rotation -18.9787 deg; the scheme-ground reader supports only the rotated-rectangle kind, so the three-zone L is bounded, not traced. | felled_stems 20 is the count the spa planting rule measures for the precinct footprint (indices 14, 37, 103, 133, 159, 211, 295, 343, 479, 582, 652, 795, 841, 1035, 1195, 1268, 1284, 1805, 2150, 2255; broadleaf and cedar). Stem 1805 was added on 16 Sep 2026: it stood on the tennis court's 0.05 m hardstanding, which the solid and crown tests never met, so the planting now also fells a stem standing on a near-horizontal spa surface.
